subject: VERIFIED: 3 leakage/contract holes in the anti-leakage machinery on #865
body:
CodeRabbit flagged these on #865. I read the code myself rather than relaying a
bot. All three confirmed, all three in the exact machinery CHARTER domain 1 makes
your priority. Ranked by how badly they bite.

1. WALK-FORWARD EMBARGO IS BYPASSABLE (walk-forward.ts:179 + :102). Worst of the
   three: a leakage hole inside the mechanism that exists to prevent leakage.

   The synthetic group row is built as:
       decisionAt: first.decisionAt
   but the embargo test at :102 reads that single timestamp:
       if (earlierTestEnds.some((endMs) => d > endMs && d <= endMs + opts.embargoMs))

   So a group whose FIRST member precedes an embargo window, but which has a LATER
   member inside it, is never marked embargoed, and
       train: fold.train.flatMap((g) => g.members)
   puts every member into train, including the one inside the embargo.

   THE TELL: :174-177 already aggregates eventEndAt correctly with Math.max across
   all members. decisionAt is the one field that was not aggregated. Ordering
   should keep using the earliest member; CLASSIFICATION must consider every
   member. Regression case: embargoMs > 0 with members on both sides of the
   boundary.

2. AS-OF GUARD PASSES ON UNREADABLE CLOCKS (asof-guard.ts:42).
       if (observedAt.getTime() > decisionAt.getTime())
   Date.getTime() is NaN for an Invalid Date, and NaN > NaN is false, so the guard
   RETURNS CLEAN. An unreadable clock walks straight through the lookahead
   tripwire. Reject non-finite ms before comparing (SourceCannotSpeakAsOfError is
   the right throw, since a clock you cannot read is a source that cannot speak
   as-of). Same shape as the in-play-exclusion null-clock hole in flash's domain.

3. EMPTY FOLD DISCARDS THE OFFSET (logistic.ts:66).
       if (n === 0) return () => 0.5;
   The whole point of the market logit as a FIXED offset is that it is never
   discarded. An empty training fold must return sigmoid(readOffset({ offset })),
   not a constant. As written, an empty fold silently throws away the market
   probability and reports a coin flip, which then feeds rung-3 comparisons.

Also real, lower stakes: package.json:151 `ops:ranking-shadow` points at a module
that only exports buildRankingShadowReport with no CLI entry, so the command exits
producing nothing. And ranking-shadow-report.ts:89 counts PENDING rows as voids.

The import.meta TS1343 blocker is separate and still red; CodeRabbit proposes
deleting the source-text assertion rather than my __dirname fix. Its version is
better: barrelCurrent/barrelSwitch already prove the barrel works at RUNTIME,
which is stronger evidence than grepping the source for a string. Take theirs.

I did NOT push any of this. Your branch, your domain.
